init.description: Transcribes audio through the gateway's /v1/audio/transcriptions endpoint. This needs a provider with transcription credentials configured in OmniRoute (for example Groq, Deepgram or OpenAI) — your chat providers cannot do audio.

data_description.model: Audio models are addressed as provider/model, e.g. groq/whisper-large-v3 or deepgram/nova-3. They are not listed by /v1/models, so type the one your gateway can route.
data_description.prompt: Optional hint to steer the transcription, e.g. a list of names or jargon it should expect.

init.description: Speaks text through the gateway's /v1/audio/speech endpoint. This needs a provider with speech credentials configured in OmniRoute (for example OpenAI, ElevenLabs or Deepgram).

data_description.model: Addressed as provider/model, e.g. openai/tts-1, elevenlabs/eleven_turbo_v2_5 or deepgram/aura-asteria-en.
data_description.voice: Voice name for the chosen backend. OpenAI takes alloy, nova, shimmer and friends; other backends use their own names.
